module: Node "Vehicle States" (category `repeat_instant`). Reads from `map.objects[vehId].states` the state of the horn (`horn`) and the lightbar (`lightbar`). Outputs: flow `horn`, flow `lightbar`, bool `hornb`, bool `lightbarb` (hidden). Input pin: `vehId`.
notes: If `map.objects[vehId]` does not exist, `horn` and `lightbar` are false but `hornb`/`lightbarb` keep their old value.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (returned by `_flowgraph_createNode(C)`). Definition fields: name, description, category, pinSchema, tags.

work.desc: Updates the horn and lightbar outputs from the `map.objects` table.
